# Knowledge System Architecture

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../), one of its top concepts._

A PKM system that integrates Obsidian Notes, Neo4j Graph Database, Claude AI, and diabetes websites with Swift and Python APIs, services, scripts, commands, and agents.

**Also known as:** KSA

## Scope note

- Includes a Diabetes AI coach with Morning Review agents that produce Day Diabetes, Day Diabetes Analysis, and Day Analysis every morning to finalize the Day Review for the previous day.
